words.definition: A region in space where the gravitational pull is so strong that nothing can escape
words.definationTranslation: Ek aisa sthaan jahaan grahakarshan itna majboot hota hai ki koi bhi cheez bahar nahi aa sakti

sentence.sentence: The black hole at the center of the galaxy is a wonder to behold
sentence.translation: Brahmaand ke kendra mein kaala chidra dekhne layak hai

sentence.sentence: Scientists have been studying black holes for decades
sentence.translation: Vaigyaanikon ne kaalon chidron ka adhyayan kai dashakon se kiya hai

words.definition: A massive, gravitationally bound system consisting of stars, stellar remnants, interstellar gas, dust, and dark matter
words.definationTranslation: Ek bada, grahakarshan se jude pranaali jismein taare, taaron ke avshesh, antara-taarakiy gas, dhool aur andhkaar padarth shaamil hain

sentence.sentence: The Milky Way is a beautiful galaxy to observe
sentence.translation: Aakaashgaanga ek sundar brahmaand hai jo dekhne layak hai

sentence.sentence: Galaxies are the building blocks of the universe
sentence.translation: Brahmaand jaise ki aakaashgaangaaon se bane hain

words.definition: A cloud of gas and dust in space
words.definationTranslation: Antariksh mein gas aur dhool ka ek baadal

sentence.sentence: The nebula is a beautiful sight to see in the night sky
sentence.translation: Tarabadi raat ke aakaash mein dekhne layak hai

sentence.sentence: Nebulae are the birthplaces of new stars
sentence.translation: Tarabaadi naye taaron ke janmsthaan hain

words.definition: The universe, especially when regarded as a well-ordered whole
words.definationTranslation: Brahmaand, vishesh roop se jab ise ek suvjit poorn roop mein dekha jaata hai

sentence.sentence: The cosmos is a complex and mysterious place
sentence.translation: Brahmaand ek jatil aur rahasyamay sthaan hai

sentence.sentence: Studying the cosmos helps us understand the universe better
sentence.translation: Brahmaand ka adhyayan hamein brahmaand ko behtar dhang se samajhne mein madad karta hai

words.definition: The study of the universe, especially the study of the stars and galaxies
words.definationTranslation: Brahmaand ka adhyayan, vishesh roop se taaron aur brahmaand ki adhyayan

sentence.sentence: Astronomy is a fascinating field of study
sentence.translation: Khaagol vigyaan ek romanchak kshetra hai adhyayan ka

sentence.sentence: Astronomers have made many important discoveries
sentence.translation: Khaagolik vigyaaniyon ne kai mahatvapoorn khojein ki hain

words.definition: An extremely luminous active galactic nucleus
words.definationTranslation: Ek atyant teevr praakshik sakriya brahmaandiyon kendra

sentence.sentence: Quasars are among the brightest objects in the universe
sentence.translation: Quasars brahmaand ke sabse teevr praakshik vastuon mein se ek hain

sentence.sentence: Quasars are thought to be powered by supermassive black holes
sentence.translation: Quasars ko atyant bade kaalon chidron dwara sakriya kiya jaata hai

words.definition: A celestial object that emits beams of electromagnetic radiation
words.definationTranslation: Ek aakaashiya vastu jo vidyut chaumbaki vikiran ki kiranon ko utsarjit karti hai

sentence.sentence: Pulsars are rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron stars
sentence.translation: Pulsars tez gati se ghumti hui, unch chaumbakiya neutron taare hain

sentence.sentence: Pulsars are used as cosmic clocks
sentence.translation: Pulsars ko brahmaandik ghadion ke roop mein upyog kiya jaata hai

words.definition: A ripple in the fabric of spacetime that is produced by the acceleration of massive objects
words.definationTranslation: Akashkaal ke vastra mein ek lhar hai jo bhaari vastuon ki gati se utpann hoti hai

sentence.sentence: The detection of gravitational waves has confirmed a key prediction of Einstein's theory of general relativity
sentence.translation: Grahakarshan tarangon ki khoj ne Einstein ki saamanya apaarativitya ki ek mahatvapoorn bhavishyavani ko saksham kiya hai

sentence.sentence: Gravitational waves carry information about their sources
sentence.translation: Grahakarshan tarangon mein unke srot ke baare mein jaankari hoti hai

words.definition: A type of matter that does not emit, absorb, or reflect any electromagnetic radiation
words.definationTranslation: Ek prakaar ki padarth jo koi bhi vidyut chaumbaki vikiran ko utsarjit, avashoshit ya pratiwarpit nahin karti

sentence.sentence: Dark matter makes up about 27% of the universe's mass-energy density
sentence.translation: Andhkaar padarth brahmaand ke sankhya-urja ghanta ke lagbhag 27% banate hain

sentence.sentence: The existence of dark matter is supported by a wide range of observational evidence
sentence.translation: Andhkaar padarth ki hasti keliye vistrit parimaan adhyayan pramaan hai

words.definition: A mysterious form of energy that is thought to be responsible for the accelerating expansion of the universe
words.definationTranslation: Ek rahasyamay oorja ka roop hai jo brahmaand ki tezi se vistaar ke liye jimmedaar mana jaata hai

sentence.sentence: Dark energy is thought to make up about 68% of the universe's mass-energy density
sentence.translation: Andhkaar oorja lagbhag 68% brahmaand ke sankhya-urja ghanta ko banaati hai

sentence.sentence: The nature of dark energy is still not well understood
sentence.translation: Andhkaar oorja ki prakriti abhi bhi acchi tarah se samajh mein nahin aati

words.definition: The fabric that combines space and time
words.definationTranslation: Akash aur samay ko milaane vaala vastra

sentence.sentence: Spacetime is the fundamental concept of modern physics
sentence.translation: Akashkaal aadhunik bhautiki ka moolbhoot avdhaarana hai

sentence.sentence: Spacetime is curved by the presence of mass and energy
sentence.translation: Akashkaal dravyamaan aur oorja ki upasthiti se vakkra hota hai

words.definition: The theory that the laws of physics are the same for all observers in uniform motion
words.definationTranslation: Vah siddhaant jo bhautiki ke niyam sabhi darshakon ke liye ek saman gati mein hain

sentence.sentence: Relativity is a fundamental concept in modern physics
sentence.translation: Apaarativitya aadhunik bhautiki mein ek moolbhoot avdhaarana hai

sentence.sentence: Relativity has been extensively tested and confirmed
sentence.translation: Apaarativitya ka vistrit parikshan kiya gaya hai aur saksham kiya gaya hai

words.definition: A point in spacetime where the curvature is infinite and the laws of physics no longer apply
words.definationTranslation: Akashkaal mein ek bindu jahaan vakkra anant hota hai aur bhautiki ke niyam lagu nahin hote

sentence.sentence: A singularity is thought to exist at the center of a black hole
sentence.translation: Vishishtata ko kaale chidre ke kendra mein maujood mana jaata hai

sentence.sentence: The laws of physics as we know them break down at a singularity
sentence.translation: Vishishtata par hum jaise bhautiki ke niyam toot jaate hain

words.definition: The boundary beyond which nothing can escape the gravitational pull of a black hole
words.definationTranslation: Seema ke pare jahaan se koi bhi kaale chidre ke grahakarshan se bach nahin sakta

sentence.sentence: The event horizon marks the point of no return for any object that crosses it
sentence.translation: Ghatnaa kaksha us bindu ko darshati hai jahaan se koi bhi vastu jo isey paar karta hai vaapas nahin aata

sentence.sentence: Once inside the event horizon, anything is trapped by the black hole's gravity
sentence.translation: Ghatnaa kaksha ke andar, kuch bhi kaale chidre ke grahakarshan se fas jaata hai

words.definition: A hypothetical tunnel through spacetime that could connect two distant points in the universe
words.definationTranslation: Ek kalpanik surang jissey akashkaal ke do dur ke bindu ko joda ja sakta hai

sentence.sentence: Wormholes are still purely theoretical and have yet to be observed
sentence.translation: Krimi surang abhi tak keval sidhaantik hain aur abhi tak dekhe nahin gaye hain

sentence.sentence: If wormholes exist, they could potentially be used for faster-than-light travel
sentence.translation: Yadi krimi surang maujood hain, to unka upyog prakash se tezi se yatra ke liye kiya ja sakta hai

words.definition: A massive star explosion that can be seen from millions of light-years away
words.definationTranslation: Ek bada taara vyasplosion jo karoib lakho prakash varsh door se dekha ja sakta hai

sentence.sentence: Supernovae are among the most powerful explosions in the universe
sentence.translation: Mahanoove brahmaand ke sabse shaktishaali vyasplosion mein se ek hain

sentence.sentence: Supernovae can briefly outshine an entire galaxy
sentence.translation: Mahanoove ek poora brahmaand ko thoda samay ke liye chamakila sakte hain

words.definition: A piece of rock or metal that has fallen to Earth from space
words.definationTranslation: Ek patthar ya dhaatu ka tukda jo antariksh se Prithvi par gira hai

sentence.sentence: Meteorites can provide valuable insights into the formation of the solar system
sentence.translation: Ulkapind soorya maandal ke nirman ke baare mein amoolya gyaan pradaan kar sakte hain

sentence.sentence: Some meteorites are thought to have originated from Mars
sentence.translation: Kuch ulkapind Mangal grah se aaye hain

words.definition: A small rocky object that orbits the Sun
words.definationTranslation: Ek chhota patthar ka vastu jo soorya ke chaaron or parikrama karta hai

sentence.sentence: Asteroids are remnants from the early days of the solar system
sentence.translation: Kshudra grah soorya maandal ke shuruaati dinon ke avshesh hain

sentence.sentence: Some asteroids are thought to be the remains of a planet that never formed
sentence.translation: Kuch kshudra grahon ko ek grah ke avshesh mana jaata hai jo kabhi banaya nahin gaya

words.definition: A small icy body that orbits the Sun and produces a bright tail of gas and dust
words.definationTranslation: Ek chhota barf se bani vastu jo soorya ke chaaron or parikrama karti hai aur gas aur dhool ka ek chamakila puchh utpann karti hai

sentence.sentence: Comets are thought to have delivered water and organic molecules to early Earth
sentence.translation: Dhumketuon ko shuruaati Prithvi par jal aur aakaarik anusoochak pahunchaane ke liye mana jaata hai

sentence.sentence: Comets are icy bodies that originate from the outer solar system
sentence.translation: Dhumketu baahari soorya maandal se utpann hone vaale barf se bane sharir hain

words.definition: A massive, luminous ball of gas that is held together by its own gravity
words.definationTranslation: Ek bada, teevr praakshik gas ka golaa jo apne swa-grahakarshan dwara jude rahta hai

sentence.sentence: Stars come in a wide range of sizes and colors
sentence.translation: Taare vibhinn aakaron aur rangon mein aate hain

sentence.sentence: The nearest star to the Sun is Proxima Centauri
sentence.translation: Soorya ke sabse nazdik taara Proxima Centauri hai

words.definition: A large, rocky or gaseous body that orbits a star
words.definationTranslation: Ek bada, patthar ya gas se bana vastu jo taare ke chaaron or parikrama karta hai

sentence.sentence: Planets can be terrestrial or gas giants
sentence.translation: Grah bhooja ya gas giant ho sakte hain

sentence.sentence: The largest planet in our solar system is Jupiter
sentence.translation: Hamaare soorya maandal ka sabse bada grah Brihaspati hai
